capabilities.summary: Platform-neutral recorder core: start/stop/status lifecycle with partial-bundle quarantine and stale-session recovery, immutable hashed session bundles (record-session v1 manifest, record-event v1 telemetry), per-field redaction before persistence, bundle verification, the step-to-frame reader, and the helper wire protocol (length-prefixed JSON via rightkit-sidecar) with ProcessBackend and serve_backend. Windows capture (Windows.Graphics.Capture and Media Foundation, src/windows, cfg(windows)) and the rightkit-record-helper binary live in this crate.
policyNotes: Declaration-only: the lifecycle, bundle writer, redaction, protocol and reader are not an ownership fingerprint.
Windows capture lives in this crate (src/windows, cfg(windows)) and is served out of process by rightkit-record-helper in serve mode.
rightkit-process owns helper spawning, supervision and restart; this crate only speaks the protocol over the streams it is given.
The macOS helper is not in this crate. It will implement Backend in its own helper and serve the same protocol.
